sam_eval: quick flag 04on new bring-up (kodama-v1 int4) we see CH->EN BLEU drop and some RTL bracket flipping. repro on staging. :confused:

hao: numbers?

sam_eval: fp16 CH->EN BLEU=29.8, int4 BLEU=23.9 (delta -5.9). zhuyin and furigana markers disappearing in many outputs; Hebrew samples sometimes show ")" before text.

mina_tokenizer: int4 shouldn't change tokenizer but logs?

ops_matt: canary logs show kernel fallback at startup and loading token_table compat layer:
```
[2026-07-02T08:11:12Z] kernel-select: requested int4_kernel_v5 -> incompatible
[2026-07-02T08:11:12Z] loading token_table /opt/tokens/compat_punct_v1.tbl
```

mina_tokenizer: compat_punct_v1 merges fullwidth punctuation into preceding han cluster and lacks bidi-aware bracket rules. that's our smoking gun.

eval-bot: auto-triage: signature "locale-token-table-fallback", similarity=0.83. impact P2.

hao: plan: 1) revert canary to force token_table=kodama_v2.tbl 2) add detok roundtrip CI for zh/ja/he 3) make kernel-selector avoid swapping token tables on fallback.

sam_eval: ran CPU fallback locally (USE_SOFT_KERNEL=1) -> BLEU=29.4 and tokens look correct. confirms runtime asset swap.

ops_matt: rolling a canary with explicit token_table pinned now, kicking off eval re-run.

mina_tokenizer: i'll open PR to require token_table pin in wheel metadata and add a small unit test to catch fullwidth punctuation boundaries + bidi bracket order.

sam_eval: adding failing samples to the ticket and holding int4 rollout until canary green. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
